messages.name: Aroha Ngata
messages.message:
Kia ora Aroha,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs.

We were impressed by your background, but we have decided not to progress your application further. We prioritized candidates who already have commercial production experience specifically in React.

Your portfolio is impressive, particularly having built 'FlatMate', a React + TypeScript app used by real people. To strengthen future applications for React-focused roles, we suggest contributing to active open-source React projects to demonstrate production-level collaboration.

Given your internship background at Pōhutukawa Digital where you worked directly with Vue, we strongly encourage you to look at the Frontend Developer (Vue) role at Pūriri Software, which matches your practical experience.

We wish you all the best with your developer journey.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Sam Patel
messages.message:
Kia ora Sam,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer role at Kauri Labs.

We are not progressing your application for this position. While we appreciate your foundational frontend training, our team needs someone who already writes TypeScript day-to-day and has deployed production applications for active users.

Your collaborative development experience with Git and pull requests during your Dev Academy project clearly showed your ability to work smoothly in a software team.

To strengthen future frontend applications, we recommend converting an existing React project to TypeScript in GitHub and deploying a live project that end users can interact with.

Given your strong commercial background alongside your new technical skills, you may want to look into the Customer Success Lead position at Rimu Retail Tech, or our Junior QA Tester role at Kauri Labs.

We wish you all the best with your software journey.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Mere Thompson
messages.message:
Kia ora Mere,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer position at Kauri Labs.

We are not moving forward with your application. Our team is specifically looking for demonstrated hands-on experience with TypeScript for this role, and while your JavaScript background is clear, TypeScript was not shown in your profile.

We were really impressed by your solid frontend foundations, particularly your experience maintaining style guides and your recent work building an accessible, responsive React site for your local kindergarten.

To strengthen your profile for modern frontend roles, we recommend highlighting any TypeScript code or modern JavaScript patterns in your portfolio projects.

You might also want to look at the Frontend Developer (returners programme) at Kōwhai Software, which supports developers returning to tech, and the Accessibility Engineer role at Tōtara Government Digital given your strong focus on WCAG.

We wish you all the best with your job search.

Ngā mihi,
The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Daniel Kim
messages.message:
Kia ora Daniel,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer position at Kauri Labs.

We are not moving forward with your application because this role requires demonstrated hands-on experience building web interfaces with React, TypeScript, and responsive CSS, which your CV does not yet show.

Your background is clearly technically capable, highlighted by your track record as a Software Engineer, Harbour Payments (2023–now) — Java and Spring Boot microservices. Given your strong current skillset, we recommend checking out the Backend Developer (Java) role at Kererū Bank, as your expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and APIs aligns very closely with what they are seeking.

We wish you the best with your ongoing learning and career progression.

The Kauri Labs team

messages.name: Priya Sharma
messages.message:

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer position at Kauri Labs.

Because your background aligns closely with fintech dashboards and requires sponsorship, we strongly encourage looking at the Frontend Developer (visa sponsorship available) position at Pōhutukawa Payments.

messages.name: Liam O'Connor

messages.name: Ben Carter
messages.message:
Kia ora Ben,

Thank you for applying for the Junior Frontend Developer position at Kauri Labs.

We have reviewed your application and won't be progressing with your candidacy for this role. While your technical background is promising, our current opening requires demonstrated depth in responsive styling and layout implementation, which wasn't fully detailed in your CV.

A clear strength in your profile is your hands-on production experience writing React and TypeScript features for an HR platform while using team Git workflows.
